# Background Information

This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) document. Instructions for writing these documents and background information can be found in the book written by @xieMarkdownDefinitiveGuide2018 When you execute code within the document, the results appear beneath the code. This file contains the pre-processing step (clean, prepare and transform data). File are split into multiple subfiles like data processing and data analyses steps, which follows the classical data-analysis pipeline [see @pengArtDataScience2016; @wickhamDataScienceImport2017].




# Notes

Global variables to control output:

```{r}
## global variables
runMplus <- FALSE
```


# get packages, raw data, functions


```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

### install and load packages
require(pacman)
p_load('tidyverse', 'jsonlite', 'magrittr', 'xlsx',
       'stargazer', 'psych', 'tm', 'MplusAutomation')


### load data files
## change working directory
setwd("data")

dat <- xlsx::read.xlsx2(file = "questionnaire.xlsx", sheetIndex = 1)
```



# data preperation


```{r}
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(c(hedonism01:relativist05), as.numeric))
```

## for second order factor model:

```{r}
setwd("output")

# select variables
vars_mplus <- c(
  paste0("hedonism", sprintf("%02d", 1:9)),
  paste0("utilitarian", sprintf("%02d", 1:9)),
  paste0("contractualist", sprintf("%02d", 1:6)),
  paste0("deontology", sprintf("%02d", 1:8)),
  paste0("virtue", sprintf("%02d", 1:9)),
  paste0("relativist", sprintf("%02d", 1:5))
)

# subset data
tmp_dat_Mplus <- dat[, vars_mplus]

# write Mplus data file
MplusAutomation::prepareMplusData(df = tmp_dat_Mplus, filename = "ESTA_CFA.dat")
```
